catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or the specialist authority specified in the current NCCP source.

clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00242 Version 6. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: Aggressive and symptomatic medullary thyroid cancer with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic disease.

treatment.schedule_summary: Vandetanib 300 mg orally once daily continuously; use a 28-day assessment-cycle convention until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
